newsitem.title: USA: New York Bagel Q4 same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: New York Bagel Q4 same-store sales rise.

text.p: New York Bagel Enterprises Inc said Monday same store sales at its company-owned restaurants in the 1996 fourth quarter rose 4.6 percent from the comparable period a year earlier.
Total sales for the fourth quarter ended Decmeber 29, 1996 from company-owned restaurants increased 75.8 percent from a year ago to $3.3 million from $1.4 million.

During the fourth quarter, New York Bagel opened three new restaurants and acquired seven restaurants from Lots A' Bagels Inc. At yearend 1996, it had 33 company-owned restaurants compared with 15 units at yearend 1995.

Same store sales for its fiscal year ended December 29, 1996 were up 4.4 percent from a year earlier. The company closed three restaurants for a total of six weeks for remodeling during 1996 compared with one restaurant closed for one week for remodeling during 1995.
Total sales from company-owned restaurants increased 58.1 percent to $10.9 million from $6.9 million last year.

Robert Geresi, chairman, chief executive officer and president of New York Bagel, said the company showed strong sales growth in restaurant sales in the fourth quarter and throughout 1996. The company exceeded its original unit development schedule and completed acquisition of certain franchisees and Lots A' Bagels, a large bagel store operator in Colorado Springs, he said.
"We will continue to focus on restaurant development and acquisitions during 1997," said Paul Hoover, vice president-strategic planning, in a statement.

Effective January 1, 1996, New York Bagel said it decided to change its fiscal yearend from a calendar yearend to a 52/53-week fiscal year, ending on the last Sunday of the year, which consists of four 13-week periods.
